settings.heading: Breathable by nature. Elevated by design.
settings.text: Natural fibres only. Here's how each one feels, wears and ages.

settings.name: Linen
settings.feel: Airy, textured, softens with every wash.
settings.care: Cold gentle wash, line dry, warm iron.

settings.name: Cotton poplin
settings.feel: Crisp, smooth, holds a sharp collar.
settings.care: Machine wash cold, hang dry, hot iron.

settings.name: Silk
settings.feel: Fluid, cool against the skin, softly lustrous.
settings.care: Hand wash cold or dry clean. Cool iron, reverse.

settings.name: Cotton-silk
settings.feel: The ease of cotton with a quiet sheen.
settings.care: Hand wash cold, dry flat, cool iron.
